lines.en: label firsttimemall:
scene chikanewmall1
I decide to spend my afternoon at the mall because-
lines.zh: 我决定把下午花在商场里，因为——

lines.en: Well, I don’t really know.
lines.zh: 好吧，其实我也不知道为什么。

lines.en: It’s probably safe to just chalk it up to some subconscious desire to hang around teenage girls, though, since that’s pretty much all there is to do with my life now.
lines.zh: 不过大概可以安全地归结为某种想跟女高中生混在一起的潜意识欲望，毕竟现在我的生活里基本也就这点事了。

lines.en: Not like there are many other things I’d prefer doing in the first place, but you get the point.
lines.zh: 倒也不是说我本来就有多少更想做的事，反正你懂的。

lines.en: Without an inkling of what to do as a middle-aged man in a shopping mall, I spend my time walking around in circles, hoping to bump into someone I know.
lines.zh: 一个中年男人在购物中心里完全不知道该干什么，我只能一圈一圈地绕着走，希望能撞见个认识的人。

lines.en: Unfortunately, this process repeats itself a good five times before I’m able to find any amount of success.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，这个过程重复了整整五次，我才勉强有点收获。

lines.en: scene black
That success comes in the form of one of the girls from my class, alone on a bench I’ve passed several times over now.
lines.zh: 这份收获以班里某个女生的形式出现，她独自坐在我已经路过好几次的长椅上。

lines.en: I doubt she’ll be happy to see me since the mall is like a...recreational sanctuary to girls her age, but that’s not something I’m going to dwell on when I’m getting desperate at this point.
lines.zh: 我怀疑她看到我不会高兴，因为商场对她这个年纪的女孩来说算是个……娱乐圣地，但事到如今我已经有点不择手段了，懒得在这上面纠结。

lines.en: Worse comes to worst, I simply walk away and the two of us forget I ever tried to talk to her in the first place.
lines.zh: 最坏无非是我直接走开，然后我们俩都忘了我曾经试图跟她搭话。

lines.en: : Sensei? Is that you?
lines.zh: : Sensei？是你吗？

lines.en: scene chikanewmall2
: Hey, Chika.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Chika。

lines.en: : Hey! It’s not often I see you outside of school. What brings you to the mall?
lines.zh: : 嗨！难得在学校外面见着你。什么风把你吹到商场来了？

lines.en: : A mix of despondence, boredom, and lack of direction. You?
lines.zh: : 沮丧、无聊和人生失去方向的混合体。你呢？

lines.en: scene chikanewmall3
: I work here. Just sat down for my break, actually.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿工作。其实是刚坐下来休息。

lines.en: : You’re welcome to join me if you want, but I doubt you’d-
lines.zh: : 你想的话可以一块儿坐，不过我猜你应该——

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: scene chikanewmall4
: Oh! Okay. Nevermind, then.
lines.zh: : 哦！好。那当我没说。

lines.en: : I didn’t really think you’d want to spend your day off hanging out with somebody like, half your age.
lines.zh: : 我真没想到你会愿意把休息日花在跟一个年纪只有你一半的人混在一起上。

lines.en: : And I didn’t think you’d want to spend your break with someone old enough to be your father, but here we are.
lines.zh: : 我也没想到你会愿意把休息时间花在一个年纪大到能当你爸的人身上，不过我们现在不就在这儿了。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. You’re not {i}that{/i} old...
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这样。你没{i}那么{/i}老吧……

lines.en: : Are you?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : I really wish I could tell you.
lines.zh: : 我真希望能告诉你。

lines.en: : Uhh...why can’t-
lines.zh: : 呃……为什么不能——

lines.en: : Anyway, which one of these stores do you work at? Maybe I can drop by sometime and like, support local business or whatever.
lines.zh: : 对了，你在这几家店里哪一家上班？也许我哪天能顺路去看看，算是……支持本地生意之类的。

lines.en: scene chikanewmall5
: If by “support local business” you mean pump some money into a major corporation, feel free to drop by. It’s the really fancy looking place at the east end of the mall.
lines.zh: : 如果你说的「支持本地生意」是指把钱塞进一家大公司口袋里，那随时欢迎你顺路来。就是商场东头那家看起来特别高级的店。

lines.en: : Does it have a weird, French name? Because I passed by a place like that earlier and couldn’t even bring myself to look inside again after catching a glimpse of the prices.
lines.zh: : 是不是有个怪里怪气的法国名字？因为我刚才路过一家那样的店，瞥了一眼价格之后，连往里再看的勇气都没有了。

lines.en: : Yup. That’s the one. I am but a humble slave to the retail machine that is {i}Les Vêtements{/i}.
lines.zh: : 对。就是那家。我不过是{i}Les Vêtements{/i}这台零售机器面前一个卑微的奴隶罢了。

lines.en: : Gotta pay the bills somehow, though. You know?
lines.zh: : 不过总得想办法付账单啊。你说是吧？

lines.en: : Sure, but I can’t imagine someone your age has very many bills to worry about.
lines.zh: : 是没错，但我没法想象你这个年纪的人有多少账单要操心。

lines.en: scene chikanewmall6
: Hahah...yeah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……是啊……

lines.en: scene chikanewmall7
: But, uhh...yeah. That’s where I work. So if you ever want to drop by just to say hi or something, feel free. I won’t pressure you into buying anything since I know how crazy expensive it all is.
lines.zh: : 不过，呃……对。那就是我上班的地方。所以你要是哪天想顺路来打个招呼什么的，随时欢迎。我不会逼你买东西的，我知道那儿的价钱有多离谱。

lines.en: : I appreciate that. Here’s hoping the “retail machine” doesn’t eat you alive.
lines.zh: : 心领了。希望那台「零售机器」别把你活活吞了。

lines.en: : Have you ever worked a job like that before, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你以前做过类似的工作吗？

lines.en: : Me? No.
lines.zh: : 我？没有。

lines.en: Or at least I don’t think so?
lines.zh: 至少我觉得没有？

lines.en: For all I know (which isn’t much on account of the whole “rebirth” thing), I could have worked in the same exact store as Chika when I was her age.
lines.zh: 就我所知的那点信息（毕竟还牵扯到整个「重生」这档子事），我在她这个年纪的时候，说不定就在跟 Chika 一模一样的店里打过工。

lines.en: Without any experience to pull from, though, I’m probably better off just steering the topic toward something else.
lines.zh: 不过既然没有任何经验可供参考，我还是把话题往别的方向引比较明智。

lines.en: : So about those bills you supposedly have to pay-
lines.zh: : 那说说你那些据说非付不可的账单——

lines.en: scene chikanewmall8
: What? No. Why? How are we back to that?
lines.zh: : 什么？不。为什么？怎么又绕回这个了？

lines.en: : I’m just curious, that’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是好奇，没别的意思。

lines.en: I’m not, really. I just don’t want to risk talking about myself before understanding a little more about...who I am or where I’m from or...anything like that.
lines.zh: 其实我并不好奇。我只是不想在还没多搞清楚一点……我是谁、我从哪儿来、或者……诸如此类的事情之前，就冒险聊起自己。

lines.en: And if making Chika slightly uncomfortable is the price to pay for saving face, I suppose she’ll just have to suffer.
lines.zh: 而如果让 Chika 稍微不自在一点，是保全面子的代价，那我想她也只能受着了。

lines.en: scene chikanewmall9
: I’ve just got...other obligations, I guess. It’s not really something I want to get into right now.
lines.zh: : 我只是有……别的开销，大概吧。现在不太想细说。

lines.en: : Other obligations? You mean like, a boyfriend?
lines.zh: : 别的开销？你是说，男朋友？

lines.en: scene chikanewmall10
: Boyfriend?! No way. Nuh-uh. It’s nothing even remotely {i}close{/i} to that. I have literally never even held hands before.
lines.zh: : 男朋友？！不可能。才没有。那玩意儿{i}根本{/i}沾不上边。我长这么大连手都没牵过。

lines.en: : My obligations are like, way more boring.
lines.zh: : 我的开销啊，无聊多了。

lines.en: : Well, I’m sorry to hear that.
lines.zh: : 这样啊，听到这个我挺遗憾的。

lines.en: But I’m not sorry I was able to confirm that Chika is, at this moment in time, completely and entirely single.
lines.zh: 但我并不遗憾自己确认了一件事：Chika 此时此刻，是完全、彻底的单身。

lines.en: : I have a hard time believing you’re completely inexperienced, though. Like, based on how you look, I kind of just figured that-
lines.zh: : 不过我真的很难相信你一点经验都没有。怎么说呢，就凭你的长相，我还以为——

lines.en: scene chikanewmall11
: What’s wrong with how I look?
lines.zh: : 我长相怎么了？

lines.en: : What? Nothing. I was just trying to say you look a lot more...{i}mature{/i} than the other girls in class.
lines.zh: : 什么？没怎么。我只是想说你看起来比班上其他女生……{i}成熟{/i}多了。

lines.en: scene chikanewmall7
: Oh! Well, that’s totally fine then.
lines.zh: : 哦！那完全没问题啦。

lines.en: : I thought you were gonna lean into that whole “gyarus are slutty” stereotype thing for a sec and I was about to get really upset.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你要往「辣妹都很骚」那套刻板印象上靠呢，刚才差点真的生气了。

lines.en: : That’s not where I was going. I just kind of figured that someone as attractive as you would be popular with the opposite sex.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思。我只是觉得，像你这么有魅力的人，应该在异性那边挺受欢迎的。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I guess I just never really-
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我猜我只是从来没有——

lines.en: scene chikanewmall12
: Wait a second. What did you just call me?
lines.zh: : 等等。你刚才叫我什么？

lines.en: : Should I not have said that?
lines.zh: : 我不该那么说吗？

lines.en: : No, you should say it again. I want to confirm that I’m not going crazy and that those words actually did just come out of your mouth.
lines.zh: : 不，你再说一遍。我想确认一下自己没疯，那些话真的是从你嘴里说出来的。

lines.en: : I’m not being recorded, am I? Because this is starting to sound like a set-up.
lines.zh: : 我没被录音吧？因为这听起来越来越像是个圈套了。

lines.en: : A set-up for what? If I didn’t want you around, do you really think I would have invited you to chill with me during my break?
lines.zh: : 什么圈套？我要是不想你在这儿，你觉得我还会邀请你在我休息的时候陪我坐着吗？

lines.en: : This is our first time spending time together outside of school. I have no idea what sorts of strategies you employ.
lines.zh: : 这可是我们第一次在校外一起待着。我完全不知道你会用什么样的策略。

lines.en: : Sensei, just friggin’ say it already. It’s totally cool.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你他妈快说就是了。真的没关系。

lines.en: : Fine. I think you’re attractive. Are you happy now?
lines.zh: : 好吧。我觉得你很有魅力。现在你满意了？

lines.en: scene chikanewmall13
: Duh! I’m obviously not gonna get upset by a compliment I basically forced out of you.
lines.zh: : 废话！一句基本是被我逼出来的夸奖，我显然不会生气啊。

lines.en: : To be fair, the first time was voluntary.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，第一次可是我自己主动说的。

lines.en: : Well...thanks, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嗯……谢谢，Sensei。

lines.en: scene chikanewmall14
: Even if we’re like, way out of each other’s dating ranges, I’m totally flattered. And, just for the record, I think you’re pretty handsome too.
lines.zh: : 虽然我们俩都远远超出对方的择偶范围了，但我真的受宠若惊。而且，郑重声明一下，我也觉得你挺帅的。

lines.en: Well, {i}now{/i} we’re getting somewhere.
lines.zh: 嗯，{i}这下{/i}总算有点进展了。

lines.en: : Oh?
scene chikanewmall15
: {i}Oh{/i} what? Don’t believe me? You want it in writing or something?
lines.zh: : {i}哦{/i}什么？不信我？要不要我写下来给你？

lines.en: : No, I think that would be just as risky as the whole recording thing.
lines.zh: : 不，我觉得那和录音一样危险。

lines.en: : Do {i}you{/i} have someone back at home, Sensei? You asked me, so it’s only fair that I get to ask you as well.
lines.zh: : Sensei，那{i}你{/i}家里有谁在等着吗？你问了我，所以我也有权问你，这才公平。

lines.en: : Me? No. I already have ten teenagers I have to keep track of and that’s more than enough for me.
lines.zh: : 我？没有。我已经有十个青少年要盯着了，对我来说够多的了。

lines.en: : Also, I {i}quite literally{/i} have Ami back at home, but that’s a totally different sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 而且，我{i}字面意义上{/i}家里还有个 Ami，不过那完全是另一回事。

lines.en: A thing that I should...probably start putting some more thought into since that is absolutely a bridge I’ll have to cross one day.
lines.zh: 一件我……大概该开始多想想的事，毕竟那绝对是一座总有一天要过的桥。

lines.en: : I would {i}really{/i} hope so! Because I’m pretty sure that would be like, way illegal.
lines.zh: : 我{i}真的{/i}希望是这样！因为我敢肯定那样的话，大概、绝对是违法的。

lines.en: : This is not a thing we should be talking about at the mall.
lines.zh: : 这种事我们不该在商场里聊。

lines.en: scene chikanewmall14
: Probs not, but we’ve been crossing boundaries for a few minutes now, so it would probably be good to start backing things up a bit.
lines.zh: : 大概是不该，不过我们这几分钟一直在越界，所以差不多也该往回收一收了。

lines.en: : Agreed. The big takeaway from today’s conversation is that we’re equally attracted to one another and that I’m going to be coming to the mall more often from now on.
lines.zh: : 同意。今天这番对话最大的收获是：我们对彼此同样有吸引力，以及从今往后我会更常来商场。

lines.en: scene chikanewmall16
: For real? You actually are?
lines.zh: : 真的？你真的会？

lines.en: : Is there a problem with that?
lines.zh: : 这有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : Not at all. It’s just...
lines.zh: : 一点都没有。只是……

lines.en: : This is all kinda coming out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 这一切都有点来得太突然了。

lines.en: : Like, just a few days ago, I looked at you as a totally normal teacher. And now we’re, like...bantering and stuff, and...
lines.zh: : 就像，就在几天前，我还把你当成一个再普通不过的老师。可现在我们已经会……互相打趣什么的了，而且……

lines.en: : I don’t know. Doesn’t this feel a little weird to you, Sensei? Like, why’d your whole outlook on teaching change all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。你不觉得这有点怪吗，Sensei？比如，你对教学的整个看法怎么突然就变了？

lines.en: : Just...woke up a brand new person, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概只是……一觉醒来变成了全新的人吧。

lines.en: scene chikanewmall15
: Well, for what it’s worth...I like this person a lot more so far.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管怎么说……到目前为止，我更喜欢这个人。

lines.en: : He’s a lot of fun to talk to if this...spontaneous meeting on a bench says anything about the kind of guy he normally is outside of school.
lines.zh: : 如果长椅上这场偶遇能说明他在校外平时是什么样的人，那他聊起天来可有意思多了。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, that’s kind of all the time I have to hang out today since I’ve gotta be getting back to work.
lines.zh: : 可惜今天我能出来玩的时间就这么多了，我得回去上班了。

lines.en: : But I’ll be looking forward to seeing you more from now on, Sensei. Both in {i}and{/i} out of school.
lines.zh: : 不过从现在起，我会期待更常见到你，Sensei。校内{i}和{/i}校外都是。

lines.en: : I’ll be looking forward to that as well.
lines.zh: : 我也一样期待。

lines.en: : See you around, Chika.
lines.zh: : 回头见，Chika。

lines.en: scene black
“The kind of guy I normally am outside of school...”
lines.zh: 「我平时在校外是什么样的人……」

lines.en: This can’t possibly be that, can it?
lines.zh: 这不可能就是那样吧？

lines.en: I was able to contain myself today, but...wasn’t it only because I was dead set on doing that?
lines.zh: 今天我克制住了自己，可是……难道只是因为我一门心思非克制不可吗？

lines.en: Moving too quickly in the beginning tends to scare people away. It doesn’t take a genius to understand that.
lines.zh: 一开始进展太快，往往会把人吓跑。这种事不需要天才才懂。

lines.en: In order to get closer, sometimes you need to lure a person into a false sense of security.
lines.zh: 为了拉近距离，有时候你得先把人引诱进一种虚假的安全感里。

lines.en: There’s no way that girl is truly {i}safe{/i} with me when I’ve already begun planting seeds in her garden.
lines.zh: 当我已经在她的花园里播下种子的时候，那个女孩不可能真正对我感到{i}安全{/i}。

lines.en: Soon, the flowers will begin to bloom and the two of us will flourish.
lines.zh: 很快，花儿就会开始绽放，我们两个也会一同繁盛。

lines.en: But it will be all because I got a head start.
lines.zh: 但这一切都会是因为我抢先了一步。

lines.en: And because she left her gate unlocked.
lines.zh: 以及，因为她没把门闩上。

lines.en: I leave the mall and try to figure out what else to do with my day.
lines.zh: 我离开商场，试图想清楚今天剩下的时间还能干点什么。

lines.en: $ firsttimemall = True
$ chika_love += 1
{i}Chika’s affection has increased to [chika_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
